name: Du Chinese: Read&Learn Chinese
description:
Du Chinese is a Chinese reading and listening app designed to help you learn Mandarin Chinese through stories. Whether you’re a beginner or working toward fluency, Du Chinese gives you the tools to read, listen, and understand Mandarin naturally, offering effective Chinese reading practice at every level. Tap to see word definitions, pinyin, native audio, and sentence translations—all without leaving the reading. Stay focused on learning, and we’ll take care of the rest.

With Du Chinese, every story is carefully written, recorded, and translated by our language experts to help you improve your Mandarin Chinese skills faster. We follow proven language learning methods to help you make real, lasting progress in your Chinese language skills. Dive deeper into your learning with detailed grammar tips, built-in dictionary, and a built-in flashcard system to reinforce your Mandarin Chinese vocabulary.

Learning that fits your lifestyle: If you are looking for a quick read before bed, quality focus time with a reading, or a story to listen to while commuting, you’ll find what you need in Du Chinese. Our extensive library of immersive Chinese stories helps you stay engaged, making Mandarin feel natural and fun, so you’ll look forward to reading Chinese every day. 

Why Du Chinese?
• Extensive library of Mandarin Chinese stories, courses, article collections, and articles
• Content for all levels: beginner, intermediate, and advanced readings (including HSK-aligned content)
• Instant access to pinyin, definitions, translations, and grammar explanations
• Native speaker audio for every reading
• Built-in dictionary and flashcards for building Chinese vocabulary
• Choose between Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
• Chinese dictionary integration with Pleco, Skritter, and Hack Chinese

Learn Chinese for free or upgrade to unlock access to:
• 3000+ articles, stories, and courses to explore
• Offline study for learning Mandarin Chinese on-the-go
• Audiobook mode for Chinese listening practice

Download Du Chinese and start reading today!
